name: Translate and polish academic texts
description: Users requested the translation of academic, scientific, or professional texts between various language pairs, with a predominant focus on rendering content into formal English or Chinese. Many requests specifically emphasized adhering to academic style conventions, polishing the language for clarity, or translating specialized terminology in fields such as medicine, engineering, and social sciences.
